featured_reviews.name: Kajal Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is a superstore. Keeps many exotic and rare eatables. It's an all in one food mall /provision store all under one roof. They keep amazing varieties in cheese, tofu and dairy products. They also have vegan options for all the health conscious people.

featured_reviews.name: NOSHIR KATRAK
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was a small shop. Slowly it improved and now it is a full fledged mini bazar.
All the possible requirements are available.
Also, imported stuff is required.
It's a human psychology, whenever we visit any Malls or such similar mini malls, at times we tend to buy items which are not actually needed. But that is for the Customer to decide.
Good snacks , chocolates, biscuits are available.
Reasonably priced and stored neatly for ease of Customer.
All packets are neatly labelled mentioning the price also.

featured_reviews.name: Nilesh Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a store selling nearly all the things required in a home kitchen for snacks, meals and breakfast. Also soaps, detergents and toothpastes. Goods are conveniently stacked and fresh & clean. Many different brands for one item is there so you can choose and buy brand of your liking. Also conveniently situated near Grand Road station.

featured_reviews.name: Urjita deshmukh-sule
featured_reviews.review_text: Good shop. Many varieties but little expensive. Staff not supportive. If u ask them any help they will run here and there. Counter staff is also same , arrogant. Once my online payment getting failed again nd again but i was waiting at counter, counter person treated me as m thief. That was my last visit. I explore new shop Nishrin just few step away which is double in size so u can shop with following social distance and many many varieties as like any mall.

featured_reviews.name: SUMIT DHAKAD
featured_reviews.review_text: Very strategically located store - at the Station end of Bhaji Gully and stones throw distance from Grant Road station and they have got so much attitude that they treat clients like peasants and don't even reply back on time.pathetic service

featured_reviews.name: samip rajani
featured_reviews.review_text: Earlier  had high regards for the above super market. But recent  experience  will tell you how bad the owners are  and arrogant.  None of the staff will wear mask.  When you wanna swipe credit card they get upset, even when tap to go facility is available. Safe for customer and safe for owner isn't  it?  But arrogance  prevails.   Owner at the cash counter  gave the machine to the customer  to enter on his own.  Super arrogant  people. BMC  hope you are taking random checks at such establishment who's staff dont even wear mask.

It's not right for any staff member to force a customer to make a purchase, especially after a customer has changed their mind about buying a product. Customer service should always be courteous and respectful.

It's concerning that you felt threatened by the staff member's insistence on making a purchase or facing police involvement. Customers should never feel pressured or coerced into buying something they don't want. It's important for the staff to understand and respect the customer's decisions and choices.

I recommend reaching out to Dmart's customer service or management team to share your experience. Providing feedback can help them address issues with staff training and customer service practices. Every customer should feel valued and respected during their shopping experience.

I hope your next visit to( soloists building new on eastern exp hwy opp sudha park kamraj Nagar ghatkopar east mumbai 400077), will be a more positive and enjoyable one. If you have any further concerns or feedback, don't hesitate to communicate with Dmart's management for a resolution.
